borough: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham
description:
Demolition of existing outbuilding and construction of a new
outbuilding, a part two storey part single storey side extension and a single
storey rear extensions including relocation of the side entrance door and
alterations to fenestration, to create a new two- storey 1x bed dwelling with
associated car parking at land adjacent to 340 Heathway Dagenham RM10 8NJ
decision_conditions: <p><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">The part two storey part single storey side extension presents an&nbsp;incongruous addition&nbsp;which would disrupt the&nbsp;homogenous appearance and&nbsp;unbalance the symmetry across the host terrace row, thus appear at adds with the character and appearance of the host dwelling, host terrace row and surrounding street scene, notably given its location within the Becontree Estate non-designated heritage asset.&nbsp;</span><span style="background-color: rgb(229, 229, 229);">As such, the proposed development is contrary to:</span><span style="background-color: rgb(229, 229, 229);"></span></p><p><span style="background-color: rgb(229, 229, 229);">-National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) (MHCLG, December 2024)&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; -Policies D4 and HC1 of the London Plan (March 2021)&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;-Policies DMD1, DMD4 and&nbsp;&nbsp;SP2&nbsp;&nbsp;of The Barking and Dagenham Local Plan (September 2024)&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></p>

<p>The applicant&nbsp;<span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">has failed to provide sufficient evidence that the proposed development would not exacerbate the existing parking stress in the area.</span><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">&nbsp;</span>As such, it fails to comply with the following policies::</p><ul><li style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 11pt;">National Planning Policy Framework (<span style="font-size: 14px; text-align: start;">MHCLG,&nbsp;</span>December 2024)</span></li><li style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 11pt;">Policies T1, T2, T4, T6 and T6.1 of the London Plan (March 2021)</span></li><li style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 11pt;">Policy DMT2 of the Barking and Dagenham Local Plan 2037 (September 2024)</span></li></ul>
